title: Water through piezoelectric spirals generating electricity
summary: Filippo Biondi tells of Water through piezoelectric spirals generating electricity, about ancient at Egypt (no place named), and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Maybe the water goes through the these spirals, and the spirals are uh made by piezoelectric material.

plain: Filippo Biondi, a scientist who says he has scanned beneath the pyramids of Egypt, offered a guess about spiral structures he links to the pyramid of Khafre at Giza. Drawing on ideas from another researcher, Christopher Dunn, he suggests that water may have flowed through these spirals, and that they may have been made of piezoelectric material, which gives off electricity when it is squeezed or stressed. If true, it would mean the pyramid worked as some kind of machine for making electricity.
